extracted.name: Easy garlic mayonnaise
extracted.description: Turn mayonnaise into garlic mayo with this quick and easy recipe. Enjoy as a dip with fries, wedges, or chicken goujons or in your favourite recipes.
instruction_lines: Place all the ingredients together with 1/2 tsp salt into a bowl. Stir well to combine. Taste, add more seasoning if desired. Chill in the fridge until serving.
